newsitem.title: USA: CME August pork bellies briefly touch limit up.
newsitem.headline: CME August pork bellies briefly touch limit up.

text.p: CME August pork belly futures briefly touched up the daily 3.00-cent-per-lb daily limit on demand prompted by a strong tone to cash bellies, traders said.
Traders cited commercial buying on word of increased slicer demand for fresh bellies.
In its closing pork cut-out report on Wednesday, USDA quoted 12- to 14-lb cash bellies at $86.00 per cwt, up $2.00 from the previous day.
Traders said cash bellies are expected to trade another $2 to $4 per cwt higher this morning.
Lind Waldock and ED and F Man International were notable buyers of August and February, they said.
At 1048 CDT, August pork bellies were 86.050 cents per lb, up 2.850 cents after touching limit up. The rest of the board was 1.000 to 1.175 cent up.
